army_rules.name: Martial Ka'tah
army_rules.flavor_text: The Adeptus Custodes have developed many thousands of martial ka'tahs. Custodians are proficient in many of these arts, shifting stances according to the battlefield situation.
army_rules.rules_text: At the start of your Command phase, friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units with this ability are readied. While a friendly unit is readied, you can select one of the Ka'tah abilities below for that unit to use. If you do, that unit is no longer readied. Each Ka'tah ability states when it can be used and its effects. Favoured Ka'tah: all detachments have a unique Shield Host Ka'tah as their Favoured Ka'tah. If a detachment selects one of these abilities, apply the additional effect listed in that detachment.

options.name: Conservai
options.rules_text: Target one friendly readied unit. Until end of turn, being engaged or Battle-shocked does not prevent it from starting an action, and starting an action does not prevent it from shooting.

options.name: Calistus
options.rules_text: When a friendly readied unit is selected to move, it can make a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move through all types of model.

options.name: Salvis
options.rules_text: When a friendly readied unit is selected to shoot, ignore modifiers to its BS and to its Hit and Wound rolls.

options.name: Dacatarai
options.rules_text: Target one friendly readied unit. Its melee attacks that target an enemy unit excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE units can re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

options.name: Kaptaris
options.rules_text: Target one friendly readied unit. Melee attacks that target your unit have -1 to Hit rolls.

options.name: Rendax
options.rules_text: When a friendly readied unit is selected to fight, its melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS: MONSTER/VEHICLE].

army_rules.name: Aegis of the Emperor
army_rules.rules_text: Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units with this ability have Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

army_rules.name: Aquila Commander
army_rules.rules_text: At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

army_rules.name: Daughters of the Abyss
army_rules.rules_text: Friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA units with this ability have Feel No Pain 3+ against psychic attacks. Psychic Null (Aura): friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units within 6 inches have Feel No Pain 5+ against psychic attacks.

army_rules.name: Anathema Psykana
army_rules.rules_text: You can include ANATHEMA PSYKANA units in your army even though they do not have the ADEPTUS CUSTODES faction keyword. When mustering your army, unless otherwise stated, you cannot select ANATHEMA PSYKANA as your army faction and cannot select an ANATHEMA PSYKANA model to be your WARLORD.

army_rules.name: Special Move Types
army_rules.rules_text: Shock Disembark Move: Set-up distance 3 inches. Eligible if embarked within a TRANSPORT on the battlefield and did not embark within that TRANSPORT this phase. Set up as described in Set Up. While moving, set up each model wholly within 3 inches of that TRANSPORT. After moving, the unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

rule.name: Assemblage of Might
rule.rules_text: In your Command phase, select one enemy unit to be a dread foe until the start of your next Command phase. Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER models' attacks that target a dread foe have +1 to Wound rolls.

enhancements.name: Shroud of the Hidden Blade
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model has Stealth and Lone Operative.

enhancements.name: Superior Creation
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY model only. Once per battle, per army, at the end of a phase in which this model is destroyed, roll one D6. On a 2+, set this model back up as close as possible to where it was destroyed, unengaged, with 3 wounds remaining.

enhancements.name: Inspirational Exemplar
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY model only. Once per battle round, per army, at the start of any phase, select one friendly Battle-shocked ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit within 9 inches. That unit is no longer Battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: Gilded Champion
stratagems.timing: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model has used a once per battle or unit ability.
stratagems.effect: Your model can use that ability one additional time, but not in the same phase. This Stratagem cannot target the same model more than once per battle.

stratagems.name: Duty Unto Death
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
stratagems.effect: When a model in your unit is destroyed before its unit has fought, roll one D6, adding 1 if the unit is led by an ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER. On a 3+, do not remove that model until its unit has fought or the phase ends.

rule.name: On Gilded Wings
rule.rules_text: At the end of your opponent's Fight phase, if a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit is unengaged, you can place that unit in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Lightning Descent
enhancements.rules_text: SHIELD-CAPTAIN IN ALLARUS TERMINATOR ARMOUR model only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an Ingress move.
restrictions: SHIELD-CAPTAIN IN ALLARUS TERMINATOR ARMOUR model only.

enhancements.name: Leonine Ferocity
enhancements.rules_text: SHIELD-CAPTAIN IN ALLARUS TERMINATOR ARMOUR model only. Once per phase, per army, you can target this unit with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem for 0CP. That use does not prevent another use of that Stratagem this phase.
restrictions: SHIELD-CAPTAIN IN ALLARUS TERMINATOR ARMOUR model only.

stratagems.name: Vigil Unending
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 Damage until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: Unleash the Lions
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit that has 2+ models.
stratagems.effect: Split your unit into separate units, each containing one model. These new units each have a Starting Strength of 1.

stratagems.name: Fury of the Emperor
stratagems.timing: Your Charge phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit that made an Ingress move this turn is selected to declare a charge.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has +2 to Charge rolls.

rule.name: Moritoi Ancients
rule.rules_text: While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit is at Starting Strength, it has +2 Objective Control. While it is below Starting Strength, its attacks can re-roll Hit rolls of 1. While it is below Half-strength, its attacks can also re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

enhancements.name: Memento Moritoi
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT model only. This model's melee attacks have +1 Attack, Strength and Damage.

enhancements.name: Augury Uplink
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT model only. This model has Feel No Pain 5+.

stratagems.name: Honoured Interred
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit.
stratagems.effect: Honoured Interred (Aura): Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units within 6 inches of this unit can re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: Unceasing Onslaught
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit ends an Advance move.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT] until end of turn. That move does not prevent it from being eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Unstoppable Momentum
stratagems.timing: Your Movement or Charge phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to move or declare a charge.

rule.name: Silent Sisterhood
rule.rules_text: When mustering your army, select a friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA CHARACTER model to be your WARLORD. Friendly PROSECUTOR SQUAD units have BATTLELINE. Friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA units have Creeping Dread (Aura): in the Battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase, each enemy unit within 12 inches that is a PSYKER unit, below Starting Strength, or making a Battle-shock roll has -1 to that roll.

enhancements.name: Oblivion Knight
enhancements.rules_text: ANATHEMA PSYKANA model only. This unit has +1 to Hit rolls. If it targets a PSYKER or Battle-shocked unit, it also has +1 to Hit and Wound rolls.

enhancements.name: Huntress' Eye
enhancements.rules_text: ANATHEMA PSYKANA model only. In your Movement phase, select one visible enemy unit within 12 inches. Until that unit makes a Battle-shock roll, it has -1 to that roll.

stratagems.name: Anathema Blademastery
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, when a friendly VIGILATOR SQUAD unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1] or [LETHAL HITS].

stratagems.name: Psy-chaff Volley
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PROSECUTOR SQUAD unit has shot.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. Until end of turn, it is prosecuted and attacks that target it have +1 AP.

stratagems.name: Purgation Sweep
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly WITCHSEEKER SQUAD unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's TORRENT attacks have +1 Attack, or +2 Attacks if they target a PSYKER or Battle-shocked unit.
